description: Kasteel Heeswijk stands in a moat, with a large round tower, a gallery, and an outer bailey of striped brick and stone with stepped gables. The square gate tower is gone, and the bridge ends at its base. The museum is closed. It is mainly clear, about 10.4°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h and cloud cover about 38%. No banner text is shown.
